scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof of the stated quadratic-model optimization is provided. Numerical checks support but do not replace proof. No claim of independent auditing or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Leading quadratic weak-noise stochastic step-equilibration cost; no full untruncated quantum-work validity theorem.
Positive scalar metric and positive local scalar noise variance on one oriented interval.
Real step count is a relaxation; integer-grid allocation statements are small-noise asymptotic.
The formal large-temperature-span qubit ratio need not be uniform in the microscopic weak-noise approximation.
Implicit prior coverage by broader variational inequalities cannot be eliminated.
title: Noise-matched step allocation in quantum thermodynamic control: exact joint optimum and integer-step limit
